english: used to refer to something already mentioned
primaryExample: I found a wallet outside the library and handed the wallet to a member of staff.
primaryTranslation: 我在图书馆外发现一个钱包，把它交给了一名工作人员。

english: To exist; to be alive; used to give information about someone or something
primaryExample: The old library will be a community centre once the building work has finally been completed.
primaryTranslation: 旧图书馆在施工全部完成后将成为一个社区中心。

english: used to join two or more things
primaryExample: The museum offers guided tours and practical workshops, so visitors can learn in several different ways.
primaryTranslation: 博物馆提供导览和实践工作坊，让游客能用几种不同方式学习。

english: belonging to or connected with something
primaryExample: The roof of the old station was damaged, so passengers had to use another entrance.
primaryTranslation: 老车站的屋顶受损，因此乘客不得不使用另一个入口。

english: move towards; in the direction of
primaryExample: We walked to the harbour after dinner because my sister wanted to photograph the fishing boats.
primaryTranslation: 晚饭后我们步行去港口，因为姐姐想拍摄渔船。

english: one (of something)
primaryExample: During the journey, a passenger offered me a seat when she noticed my heavy bag.
primaryTranslation: 旅途中，一位乘客注意到我沉重的包，便给我让了座。

english: being inside something
primaryExample: The documents were still in my backpack, although I thought I had left them at home.
primaryTranslation: 文件仍在我的背包里，尽管我以为自己把它们落在家里了。

english: to own, possess, or hold something
primaryExample: We have a spare room upstairs, so my cousin can stay whenever she visits the city.
primaryTranslation: 我们楼上有一间空房，所以表妹来这座城市时随时可以住下。

english: used to refer to a thing that is known
primaryExample: I bought a second-hand bicycle last month, and it has made my journey to work much easier.
primaryTranslation: 我上个月买了一辆二手自行车，它让我的上班路程轻松多了。

english: used to refer to a person someone is speaking or writing to
primaryExample: If you explain the problem clearly, the support team will be able to help more quickly.
primaryTranslation: 如果你清楚地说明问题，支持团队就能更快地提供帮助。

english: used to refer to the male person or animal that is known
primaryExample: My brother wanted to become a chef, so he started helping in a restaurant after school.
primaryTranslation: 我弟弟想当厨师，所以放学后开始在一家餐馆帮忙。

english: used to show the purpose, or need of something
primaryExample: We bought a small tent for our weekend trip, hoping the weather would stay dry.
primaryTranslation: 我们为周末旅行买了一顶小帐篷，希望天气保持晴朗。

english: used to refer to two or more people, animals, or things that are known
primaryExample: The volunteers arrived before sunrise because they needed enough time to prepare the outdoor stage.
primaryTranslation: 志愿者们日出前就到了，因为他们需要足够时间准备户外舞台。

english: word indicating the negative of verbs, adjectives, etc.
primaryExample: The tickets are not refundable, so please check the travel dates carefully before you book.
primaryTranslation: 这些票不能退款，因此预订前请仔细核对出行日期。

english: used to show which person or thing we are talking about
primaryExample: Several boxes looked similar, but that was the one containing the photographs we had been searching for.
primaryTranslation: 几个箱子看起来很像，但那个才装着我们一直寻找的照片。

english: used to refer to the speaker and other people together
primaryExample: Although the route was longer than expected, we reached the village before the last bus left.
primaryTranslation: 虽然路线比预期长，但我们在末班车离开前到达了村子。

english: located on the surface of something (e.g., a table or wall)
primaryExample: Please leave the parcel on the kitchen table, where my neighbour will find it this evening.
primaryTranslation: 请把包裹放在厨房桌子上，我邻居今晚会在那里找到它。

english: used to express that people or things are together
primaryExample: I travelled with two colleagues who knew the area well and suggested several interesting places to visit.
primaryTranslation: 我和两位熟悉当地的同事同行，他们推荐了几个有趣的游览地点。

english: person, thing, or idea near you
primaryExample: I have compared several routes, and this is the one that gives us the best coastal views.
primaryTranslation: 我比较了几条路线，这条能让我们欣赏到最好的海岸景色。

english: used by a speaker or writer to refer to himself/herself
primaryExample: Although I had never repaired a bicycle before, I managed to replace the broken chain myself.
primaryTranslation: 虽然我以前从没修过自行车，但还是设法自己更换了断掉的链条。

english: to act; to perform actions
primaryExample: We should do the most difficult tasks first, while everyone still has plenty of energy.
primaryTranslation: 我们应该先做最难的任务，趁大家精力还很充沛。

english: a word used to compare two equal things
primaryExample: The replacement battery lasts as long as the original, although it costs considerably less to buy.
primaryTranslation: 替换电池的续航和原装一样长，购买价格却低很多。

english: in the place where something is
primaryExample: We agreed to meet at the main entrance because the exhibition centre has several smaller doors.
primaryTranslation: 我们约定在正门见面，因为展览中心还有几个较小的门。

english: used to refer to the female person or animal that is known
primaryExample: Our neighbour grows vegetables on her balcony, and she often shares the extra tomatoes with us.
primaryTranslation: 邻居在阳台种菜，她经常把多余的番茄分给我们。

english: used before you say something different, opposite
primaryExample: The apartment is smaller than we expected, but its large windows make every room feel bright.
primaryTranslation: 这套公寓比我们预期的小，但大窗户让每个房间都很明亮。

english: starting at a particular place, time, or level
primaryExample: The walking route begins from the old bridge and continues along the river towards the forest.
primaryTranslation: 这条步行路线从老桥开始，沿河一直通往森林方向。

primaryCollocations.chinese: 从一个地方到另一个地方

english: near; with
primaryExample: We waited by the ticket office, where a member of staff explained why the train was delayed.
primaryTranslation: 我们在售票处旁等候，一名工作人员在那里解释了火车晚点的原因。

english: used with verbs to express the future
primaryExample: The new sports centre will open next spring, provided that the final building checks go well.
primaryTranslation: 如果最后的建筑检查顺利，新体育中心将于明年春天开放。

english: used to link alternatives, to introduce another choice
primaryExample: You can submit the form online or bring a printed copy to the office before Friday.
primaryTranslation: 你可以在周五之前在线提交表格，或把打印件带到办公室。

english: to use words to tell a message
primaryExample: Please say what you really think about the design, because we still have time to improve it.
primaryTranslation: 请说出你对设计的真实看法，因为我们还有时间改进。

english: to move or travel to another place
primaryExample: We decided to go to the smaller museum, which had an excellent exhibition about local history.
primaryTranslation: 我们决定去那家较小的博物馆，那里有很精彩的地方历史展。

english: for that reason
primaryExample: The road through the mountains was closed, so our driver had to find a different route.
primaryTranslation: 穿山公路封闭了，所以司机不得不另找一条路线。

english: completely; totally
primaryExample: By the time the guests arrived, the children were all dressed and ready for the celebration.
primaryTranslation: 客人们到达时，孩子们都已穿戴整齐，准备参加庆祝活动。

english: introducing a condition for something to happen
primaryExample: If the weather improves by lunchtime, we can finish our picnic and explore the nearby village.
primaryTranslation: 如果午饭前天气好转，我们就能吃完野餐，再去逛附近的村子。

english: number 1
primaryExample: Only one seat was available on the earlier train, so we decided to travel together later.
primaryTranslation: 早一班火车只剩一个座位，所以我们决定晚些一起走。

english: modal verb used to indicate possibility, request, etc.
primaryExample: Would you mind explaining the instructions again, since several people joined after the meeting had started?
primaryTranslation: 你介意再解释一次说明吗？因为有几个人在会议开始后才加入。

english: of (a subject); concerning
primaryExample: The guide told us about the castle's history while we climbed the narrow stairs to the tower.
primaryTranslation: 我们爬上通往塔楼的狭窄楼梯时，导游给我们讲了城堡的历史。

english: to be able to; have the skill to; have the time to
primaryExample: With a little practice, you can prepare this meal in less time than it takes to order food.
primaryTranslation: 稍加练习，你做出这顿饭的时间就能比点外卖还短。

english: question word to ask about a person's choice
primaryExample: Which route would you recommend for visitors who want to avoid traffic and enjoy the countryside?
primaryTranslation: 对于想避开交通拥堵并欣赏乡村风景的游客，你会推荐哪条路线？

english: in that place or position, at that location
primaryExample: We spent a weekend in the village and discovered that several artists had moved there recently.
primaryTranslation: 我们在村里度过了一个周末，发现最近有几位艺术家搬到了那里。

english: to have knowledge of things in your mind
primaryExample: Although I know the main road well, I always check the map before trying a different route.
primaryTranslation: 虽然我很熟悉主路，但尝试别的路线前总会查地图。

english: greater in amount, number, or size
primaryExample: We need more volunteers for the weekend event because the number of visitors has increased considerably.
primaryTranslation: 周末活动需要更多志愿者，因为游客数量大幅增加了。

english: to obtain, receive, or be given something
primaryExample: You can get a free map at reception, which shows all the walking routes around the lake.
primaryTranslation: 你可以在接待处领取免费地图，上面标着所有环湖步行路线。

english: what or which person or people, to ask about, talking about
primaryExample: Do you know who organised the workshop, because I would like to thank them for their help?
primaryTranslation: 你知道是谁组织了这次工作坊吗？我想感谢他们的帮助。

english: to find something pleasing; to prefer something
primaryExample: I like working near the window because the natural light helps me concentrate during the afternoon.
primaryTranslation: 我喜欢在窗边工作，因为自然光能帮助我在下午集中注意力。

english: word you use to ask about the time or day
primaryExample: We need to decide when the course should begin so that everyone has enough time to prepare.
primaryTranslation: 我们需要决定课程何时开始，好让每个人都有足够时间准备。

english: to have an idea, opinion, or belief about something
primaryExample: I think the smaller venue would suit our event better, especially if fewer guests decide to come.
primaryTranslation: 我觉得较小的场地更适合我们的活动，尤其是在来宾减少的情况下。

english: to create something by putting things together
primaryExample: The children used recycled cardboard to make a model bridge that could support several small toy cars.
primaryTranslation: 孩子们用回收纸板制作了一座能承受几辆小玩具车的桥模型。

english: something measured in minutes, hours, days, etc.
primaryExample: We allowed extra time for the journey because the roads near the airport were being repaired.
primaryTranslation: 我们为行程多留了时间，因为机场附近的道路正在维修。

english: to use your eyes to look at something
primaryExample: From the upstairs window, we could see fishing boats returning to the harbour as the sun rose.
primaryTranslation: 从楼上窗户，我们能看见渔船随着太阳升起驶回港口。

english: asking for information about someone or something
primaryExample: Please explain what the new symbols mean before we start using the updated version of the map.
primaryTranslation: 在我们开始使用新版地图前，请解释一下这些新符号是什么意思。

english: move higher; raise
primaryExample: The path climbs up the hillside before reaching a small café with wonderful views across the valley.
primaryTranslation: 小路沿山坡向上，最后通往一家能俯瞰山谷美景的小咖啡馆。

english: used to refer to a person or thing that is not known
primaryExample: We bought some fresh bread from the village bakery before setting off on our long journey home.
primaryTranslation: 在踏上漫长的回家路之前，我们在村里的面包店买了些新鲜面包。

english: something else; not the first one
primaryExample: The main entrance was closed for repairs, so visitors had to use the other door beside the café.
primaryTranslation: 正门因维修关闭，游客只好使用咖啡馆旁的另一扇门。

english: away from the inside or center
primaryExample: The children hurried out of the classroom when they heard that the snow had finally started falling.
primaryTranslation: 听说终于开始下雪了，孩子们急忙跑出了教室。

english: excellent; high quality
primaryExample: The hotel received good reviews because its staff were helpful and the rooms were carefully maintained.
primaryTranslation: 这家酒店获得了好评，因为员工热心，房间也维护得很好。

english: human beings in general; plural of person
primaryExample: More people are choosing to cycle to work now that the city has built safer bicycle lanes.
primaryTranslation: 城市建起更安全的自行车道后，更多人选择骑车上班。

english: unit of time equal to 12 months
primaryExample: We visit the same village every year, although we usually explore a different area of the countryside each time.
primaryTranslation: 我们每年都去同一个村子，不过每次通常会探索不同的乡村区域。

english: to pick up something and go away with it
primaryExample: Please take your umbrella when you leave, because the forecast suggests that heavy rain will return later.
primaryTranslation: 离开时请带上雨伞，因为天气预报说稍后还会有大雨。

english: being none; not having or being
primaryExample: There was no space left in the cupboard, so we moved the extra plates to another room.
primaryTranslation: 橱柜里没有空间了，所以我们把多余的盘子移到了另一个房间。

english: in a good way
primaryExample: The two teams work well together, even though they approach difficult problems in very different ways.
primaryTranslation: 这两个团队合作得很好，尽管他们处理难题的方式很不相同。

english: for a reason
primaryExample: We booked an earlier train because we wanted enough time to explore the city before the concert.
primaryTranslation: 我们订了更早的火车，因为想在音乐会前有足够时间游览城市。

english: much; great in amount
primaryExample: The instructions were very clear, so everyone managed to assemble the shelves without asking for help.
primaryTranslation: 说明非常清楚，所以大家不用寻求帮助就装好了架子。

english: only; a short time ago
primaryExample: I have just finished the report, so I can send you a copy before the afternoon meeting.
primaryTranslation: 我刚刚完成报告，所以能在下午的会议前发给你一份。

english: to move toward someone; go with someone
primaryExample: Please come to the community meeting if you would like to help improve our local park.
primaryTranslation: 如果你想帮助改善当地公园，请来参加社区会议。

english: used as the past form of can, to show possibility
primaryExample: When we lived near the coast, we could walk to the beach after dinner almost every evening.
primaryTranslation: 以前住在海边时，我们几乎每晚饭后都能步行去海滩。

english: activity you do in order to make money
primaryExample: She enjoys her work at the museum because every exhibition gives her an opportunity to learn something new.
primaryTranslation: 她喜欢博物馆的工作，因为每次展览都让她有机会学到新东西。

english: to do something with, for a task or purpose
primaryExample: We use a shared calendar so that everyone knows when the meeting rooms are available for booking.
primaryTranslation: 我们使用共享日历，让大家都知道会议室何时可以预订。

english: used when comparing two things
primaryExample: The new library is much quieter than the old one, making it easier for students to concentrate.
primaryTranslation: 新图书馆比旧馆安静得多，让学生们更容易集中注意力。

english: at the present time or moment
primaryExample: The bridge has reopened, and drivers can now reach the town without taking a long route through the hills.
primaryTranslation: 桥已经重新开放，司机们现在无需绕行山区就能到镇上。

english: at that time not now
primaryExample: We arrived in the village before sunrise, and the streets were almost completely empty back then.
primaryTranslation: 我们日出前到达村子，那时候街道上几乎完全没有人。

english: in addition; too; in a similar way
primaryExample: The course teaches practical cooking skills, but it also explains how to plan meals on a limited budget.
primaryTranslation: 课程教授实用烹饪技能，也讲解如何在预算有限的情况下安排膳食。

english: going inside something
primaryExample: The guide led us into a narrow tunnel that connected the old house to the nearby river.
primaryTranslation: 导游带我们进入一条狭窄隧道，它把老房子和附近的河连接起来。

english: just one; just that amount or thing; not more than
primaryExample: Only a few visitors stayed until closing time, so we had a peaceful view of the final exhibition.
primaryTranslation: 只有少数游客待到闭馆，所以我们能安静地欣赏最后一个展览。

english: to turn your eyes in a particular direction
primaryExample: Please look at the diagram carefully before you connect the cables to the back of the computer.
primaryTranslation: 把电缆接到电脑背面之前，请仔细看一下示意图。

english: to desire or wish for something; hope for a thing
primaryExample: We want to find a quieter place to stay, preferably somewhere within walking distance of the station.
primaryTranslation: 我们想找一个更安静的住宿地点，最好离车站只有步行距离。

english: to hand over or present something to someone
primaryExample: The receptionist will give you a visitor's badge after you have written your name in the book.
primaryTranslation: 你在登记簿上写下姓名后，接待员会给你一张访客证。

english: coming before all others in time or place
primaryExample: Our first attempt failed because we had not checked whether all the pieces fitted together correctly.
primaryTranslation: 我们的第一次尝试失败了，因为没有检查所有零件是否正确吻合。

english: not old, recently born, built, or made
primaryExample: The new walking route passes several small farms that visitors could not easily reach before the bridge opened.
primaryTranslation: 新步行路线经过几座小农场，桥开通前游客很难到达那里。

english: how something is done
primaryExample: We need a better way to share information so that important messages do not get lost.
primaryTranslation: 我们需要更好的信息共享方法，以免重要消息遗漏。

english: to discover something by looking for it
primaryExample: After searching through several boxes, I finally managed to find the photographs my grandmother had mentioned.
primaryTranslation: 翻找几个箱子后，我终于找到了奶奶提过的照片。

chinese: 在...上面；穿越；多于；在...另一边
english: above; across; more than; on the other side
primaryExample: We crossed over the wooden bridge slowly because some of the boards were slippery after the rain.
primaryTranslation: 我们慢慢走过木桥，因为雨后有些木板很滑。

english: one (thing) of many; some (thing)
primaryExample: If you have any questions about the schedule, please speak to the organiser before the session begins.
primaryTranslation: 如果你对日程有任何疑问，请在活动开始前向组织者询问。

english: later than another time, or behind something
primaryExample: We watched the children enter the museum, and their teacher followed shortly after with the tickets.
primaryTranslation: 我们看着孩子们走进博物馆，不久后老师拿着票跟了进去。

english: a period of 24 hours
primaryExample: We spent a whole day exploring the island, stopping whenever we found a quiet beach or interesting village.
primaryTranslation: 我们花了一整天游览岛屿，每遇到安静的海滩或有趣的村子就停下来。

english: word you use to ask the location of something
primaryExample: The guide explained where we should wait if the group became separated during the busy festival.
primaryTranslation: 导游说明了，如果节日期间人多导致队伍走散，我们应该在哪里等候。

english: something you cannot remember the name of
primaryExample: I cannot remember the name of the small thing that keeps the cupboard door firmly closed.
primaryTranslation: 我记不起来那个能把橱柜门扣紧的小东西叫什么。

english: nearly all of something
primaryExample: Most of the volunteers had never met before, but they quickly learned how to work together.
primaryTranslation: 大多数志愿者以前从未见过，却很快学会了如何合作。

english: used to indicate what is proper or reasonable
primaryExample: You should keep a copy of the receipt in case you need to return the product later.
primaryTranslation: 你应该保存一份收据，以防之后需要退货。

english: to be unable to manage without something; require
primaryExample: We need a larger room for the workshop because more people have registered than we originally expected.
primaryTranslation: 工作坊需要更大的房间，因为报名人数超出了最初预期。

english: a lot; large amount; a high degree of
primaryExample: Much of what we learned during the workshop can be used immediately in our everyday work.
primaryTranslation: 我们在工作坊学到的许多东西，都能立刻用于日常工作。

english: on side where the hand that most people write with
primaryExample: Keep your bag in your right hand while you use the other hand to hold the rail.
primaryTranslation: 用右手提着包，同时用另一只手扶住栏杆。

english: in what way something happens or is done
primaryExample: The instructor explained how we could adjust the camera settings to take clearer photographs in poor light.
primaryTranslation: 教练讲解了如何调整相机设置，以便在光线差时拍出更清晰的照片。

english: behind; to the rear; previous
primaryExample: We used the back entrance because a delivery van was blocking the main door of the shop.
primaryTranslation: 我们走了后门，因为一辆送货车挡住了商店正门。

english: to have a particular meaning or value
primaryExample: The coloured lines mean different things, so check the guide before you begin following the route.
primaryTranslation: 这些彩色线条含义不同，所以沿路线走之前先查看指南。

english: as well; too
primaryExample: The basic ticket includes the gardens and even gives visitors access to the newly restored tower.
primaryTranslation: 基础门票包含花园，甚至还允许游客进入新修复的塔楼。

english: used to talk about what is possible
primaryExample: The outdoor concert may finish earlier than planned if the temperature drops sharply after the sun goes down.
primaryTranslation: 如果日落后气温骤降，户外音乐会可能会提前结束。

english: in, at, or to this position or place
primaryExample: Please leave your bicycle here while you collect your ticket from the office across the road.
primaryTranslation: 你去马路对面的办公室取票时，请把自行车留在这里。

english: used to refer to a large number of things
primaryExample: Many local shops stayed open late because the festival attracted visitors from all over the region.
primaryTranslation: 许多当地商店营业到很晚，因为节日吸引了整个地区的游客。

english: so like, or similar
primaryExample: We had never seen such clear water before, so we spent the whole afternoon beside the lake.
primaryTranslation: 我们从没见过如此清澈的水，于是在湖边待了整个下午。

english: the most recent; coming after all others
primaryExample: The last bus leaves before the exhibition closes, so we will need to arrange another way home.
primaryTranslation: 末班车在展览闭馆前发车，因此我们得另想办法回家。

english: a very young person, between about 2 and 15
primaryExample: Every child who joins the activity must bring a warm coat, even if the morning seems sunny.
primaryTranslation: 参加活动的每个孩子都必须带厚外套，即使早上看起来天气晴朗。

english: to say or communicate information to someone
primaryExample: Please tell the receptionist if you need a quieter room, as several alternatives are still available upstairs.
primaryTranslation: 如果你需要更安静的房间，请告诉接待员，楼上还有几个可选房间。

english: very
primaryExample: The new cycle path is really useful because it connects our neighbourhood directly to the station.
primaryTranslation: 新自行车道非常实用，因为它把我们的社区直接连到了车站。

english: to phone someone
primaryExample: I will call the shop tomorrow morning to check whether the replacement part has finally arrived.
primaryTranslation: 我明早会给商店打电话，确认替换零件是否终于到货。

english: at a time earlier than the present; previously
primaryExample: We had visited the village before, but we had never explored the forest beyond the old mill.
primaryTranslation: 我们以前到过这个村子，却从未探索过老磨坊外的森林。

english: a business that sells things or provides services
primaryExample: The company offers flexible working hours, allowing employees to avoid the busiest trains during the morning.
primaryTranslation: 这家公司提供弹性工作时间，让员工能避开早上最拥挤的火车。

english: from one end or side of something to the other end or side
primaryExample: We followed the path through the forest until we reached a clearing beside a narrow stream.
primaryTranslation: 我们沿着穿过森林的小路前进，最后到达一条小溪旁的空地。

english: going from a higher position to a lower position
primaryExample: The children walked down the steep steps carefully because the stone surface was wet from rain.
primaryTranslation: 孩子们小心地走下陡峭台阶，因为石面被雨水打湿了。

english: to explain or teach how something is done
primaryExample: Could you show the new volunteers how to use the equipment before the first visitors arrive?
primaryTranslation: 你能在首批游客到来前，教新志愿者如何使用这些设备吗？

english: all the living things (e.g., animals, plants, humans)
primaryExample: The discovery of plant life in the tiny pond encouraged the children to study its surroundings more carefully.
primaryTranslation: 小池塘里发现植物生命，促使孩子们更仔细地研究周围环境。

english: an adult male human being
primaryExample: A man waiting outside the station offered to help when he saw us struggling with our suitcases.
primaryTranslation: 一位在车站外等候的男子看到我们费力地搬行李，主动提出帮忙。

english: to make or become different, or into something else
primaryExample: We may need to change our plans if the museum remains closed throughout the school holidays.
primaryTranslation: 如果博物馆在整个学校假期都闭馆，我们可能需要改变计划。

english: to put something in a certain location or position
primaryExample: Please place the completed forms in the blue tray so that staff can collect them later.
primaryTranslation: 请把填好的表格放进蓝色托盘，方便工作人员稍后收取。

english: large distance from one end to the other
primaryExample: A long wooden bridge connects the island to the shore, allowing visitors to cross on foot.
primaryTranslation: 一座很长的木桥把岛屿和岸边连起来，游客可以步行通过。

english: in the space that separates two objects
primaryExample: The little café stands between the library and the station, making it a convenient meeting place.
primaryTranslation: 小咖啡馆位于图书馆和车站之间，是一个方便的会面地点。

english: to be aware of or experience an emotion or sensation
primaryExample: I feel much more confident about speaking English now that I practise with a partner every week.
primaryTranslation: 现在我每周都和搭档练习，对说英语自信多了。

english: say that something is more than you want
primaryExample: The room was too crowded for a practical workshop, so the organiser moved us into the hall.
primaryTranslation: 房间太挤，无法开展实践工作坊，因此组织者让我们移到了大厅。

english: happening in the past and continuing into the present
primaryExample: We still use the wooden table my grandfather made, although its surface has become slightly uneven.
primaryTranslation: 我们仍在用爷爷做的木桌，虽然桌面已经有些不平了。

english: something difficult to deal with or causes trouble
primaryExample: The main problem was the lack of storage space, which made the small kitchen difficult to organise.
primaryTranslation: 主要问题是缺少储物空间，这让小厨房很难整理。

english: to make letters and words on paper or a screen
primaryExample: Please write your contact details clearly so that the organiser can reach you if the schedule changes.
primaryTranslation: 请清楚填写联系方式，方便组织者在日程变动时联系你。

english: identical; not different
primaryExample: We chose the same hotel as last year because its location had made exploring the city easy.
primaryTranslation: 我们选了去年的同一家酒店，因为它的位置方便游览城市。

english: A large quantity, or number taken together
primaryExample: We learned a lot from the first attempt, even though the model did not work as expected.
primaryTranslation: 虽然模型没有按预期运作，但第一次尝试让我们学到了很多。

english: very good; fantastic; wonderful
primaryExample: The community garden has been a great success, bringing together neighbours who rarely spoke to each other before.
primaryTranslation: 社区花园取得了巨大成功，让以前很少交谈的邻居们聚在一起。

english: to make an effort, to attempt to do something
primaryExample: We should try a different route tomorrow because the coastal road is likely to be very busy.
primaryTranslation: 我们明天应该尝试别的路线，因为沿海道路可能会很拥堵。

english: to go away from; depart
primaryExample: We decided to leave the campsite early so that we could reach the village before the storm.
primaryTranslation: 我们决定提早离开营地，以便在暴风雨前赶到村子。

english: symbols such as 1, 2, 56, 793
primaryExample: Write the reference number on the envelope so that staff can match your documents to the correct application.
primaryTranslation: 请在信封上写明参考编号，方便工作人员把文件匹配到正确的申请。

english: used to refer to two things at the same time
primaryExample: Both routes offer beautiful views, but the one along the coast is easier for inexperienced walkers.
primaryTranslation: 两条路线景色都很美，但沿海那条更适合没有经验的徒步者。

english: yours, his, hers, etc.; not belonging to another
primaryExample: We prepared our own lunch instead of buying food, which helped us keep the trip affordable.
primaryTranslation: 我们自备午饭而没有买吃的，这有助于控制旅行费用。

english: some, but not all of a specific thing
primaryExample: We repaired the damaged part of the fence before the animals were allowed back into the field.
primaryTranslation: 动物们获准回到田里前，我们修好了围栏受损的部分。

english: to indicate something with your finger to others
primaryExample: Please point to the symbol on the map so that everyone understands which entrance we should use.
primaryTranslation: 请指一下地图上的符号，让大家都明白该使用哪个入口。

english: not great in size, amount, or degree; small
primaryExample: The little house beside the bridge has been carefully restored and now welcomes visitors during summer.
primaryTranslation: 桥边的小房子经过精心修复，现在夏季会接待游客。

english: to act to enable a person to do something; assist
primaryExample: The guide offered to help us choose a walking route that would suit everyone in our group.
primaryTranslation: 导游主动帮助我们选择一条适合队里所有人的徒步路线。

english: to say to someone that you want something
primaryExample: You should ask a member of staff for permission before taking photographs inside the main exhibition hall.
primaryTranslation: 在主展厅内拍照前，你应该先向工作人员请求许可。

english: to come together at a certain time or place
primaryExample: We arranged to meet outside the library because everyone could reach it easily by public transport.
primaryTranslation: 我们约好在图书馆外见面，因为大家坐公共交通都能方便到达。

english: first time or place that a thing exists; beginning
primaryExample: The start of the walking tour was delayed because several visitors had difficulty finding the meeting point.
primaryTranslation: 徒步导览推迟开始，因为几位游客找不到集合地点。

english: to say things or ideas to someone with words
primaryExample: We should talk about the problem calmly before deciding whether the original plan needs to be changed.
primaryTranslation: 我们应该先冷静讨论问题，再决定是否需要更改原计划。

english: thing that is not yet known or named
primaryExample: I need something that will keep these papers together without damaging the photographs attached to them.
primaryTranslation: 我需要一个能把这些纸夹在一起、又不损伤所附照片的东西。

english: to move or place a thing in a particular position
primaryExample: Please put the chairs against the wall so that there is enough space for the group activity.
primaryTranslation: 请把椅子靠墙放，为小组活动留出足够空间。

primaryCollocations.english: put a book on the table

english: one more (thing); additional (thing)
primaryExample: We need another volunteer to welcome visitors while the rest of the team prepares the main hall.
primaryTranslation: 我们还需要一名志愿者接待游客，同时其余队员准备大厅。

english: to begin to be; grow to be; develop into
primaryExample: With regular practice, tasks that once seemed difficult can become much easier to complete without help.
primaryTranslation: 经常练习后，曾经看似困难的任务会变得更容易独立完成。

english: to make someone want to know about something
primaryExample: The guide used old photographs to interest visitors in the everyday lives of the village's former residents.
primaryTranslation: 导游用老照片激发游客对村中昔日居民日常生活的兴趣。

english: an area of land that is controlled by a government
primaryExample: Travelling through the country by train allowed us to see places that most tourists never visit.
primaryTranslation: 乘火车穿越这个国家，让我们看到了多数游客从不到访的地方。

english: having existed for a long time, not young or new
primaryExample: The old bridge is no longer used by cars, but people still cross it on foot.
primaryTranslation: 这座老桥已不再通汽车，但人们仍会步行过桥。

english: every one of two or more things
primaryExample: Each participant received a different photograph and was asked to describe it without showing it to anyone.
primaryTranslation: 每位参与者收到一张不同的照片，要在不展示给别人的情况下描述它。

english: building where you learn in classes with a teacher
primaryExample: The school opened its library on Saturdays so that local families could borrow books together.
primaryTranslation: 学校周六开放图书馆，方便当地家庭一起借书。

english: happening near the end of a given time
primaryExample: We enjoyed a late dinner after the concert, when most of the nearby restaurants were already closed.
primaryTranslation: 音乐会后我们很晚才吃晚饭，当时附近多数餐馆已经关门。

english: rising upward a great distance
primaryExample: The high wall protected the garden from strong winds, allowing several delicate plants to grow successfully.
primaryTranslation: 高墙挡住了强风，让几种娇弱的植物得以顺利生长。

english: not of the same kind; unlike other things
primaryExample: We tried three different methods before finding one that was simple enough for everyone to use.
primaryTranslation: 我们尝试了三种不同方法，才找到一种人人都能使用的简单方法。

english: away from; not on
primaryExample: The cover was off the machine, so the technician could see which part needed to be replaced.
primaryTranslation: 机器外罩已经取下，技术员因此能看出哪个零件需要更换。

english: immediately after the previous one
primaryExample: The next stage of the project involves testing the design with people who have never seen it before.
primaryTranslation: 项目的下一阶段，是让从没见过设计的人来测试它。

english: a point that marks the limit of something; finish
primaryExample: We waited until the end of the performance before asking the musicians about their unusual instruments.
primaryTranslation: 我们等到演出结束，才向音乐家询问那些不寻常的乐器。

english: to be alive
primaryExample: Some trees can live for hundreds of years if they have enough space and suitable growing conditions.
primaryTranslation: 有足够空间和合适生长条件时，有些树能活数百年。

english: for what reason or purpose
primaryExample: Nobody understood why the lights kept going out until the technician checked the old wiring carefully.
primaryTranslation: 直到技术员仔细检查了旧线路，大家才明白为什么灯总是熄灭。

english: during the time that; at the same time
primaryExample: I prepared the vegetables while my brother read the recipe and checked which ingredients we still needed.
primaryTranslation: 我准备蔬菜时，弟弟读食谱并核对我们还缺哪些食材。

english: all the humans, events, activities on the earth
primaryExample: The festival brings together musicians from around the world, giving local audiences a chance to discover unfamiliar styles.
primaryTranslation: 音乐节汇集世界各地的音乐家，让当地观众有机会接触陌生的风格。

english: period of seven days, starts on Sunday and end on Saturday
primaryExample: We spent a week in the countryside, exploring small villages and learning how local farmers produced cheese.
primaryTranslation: 我们在乡下待了一周，游览小村庄，了解当地农民如何制作奶酪。

english: to do or perform a game or sport
primaryExample: We usually play basketball after school, unless the sports hall is being used for another activity.
primaryTranslation: 我们通常放学后打篮球，除非体育馆被其他活动占用了。

english: used to express that something could happen
primaryExample: The café might be closed when we arrive, so it would be sensible to bring some food.
primaryTranslation: 我们到达时咖啡馆可能关门，所以带些食物比较稳妥。

english: used to say that something is required or necessary
primaryExample: Visitors must keep to the marked paths because several areas contain plants that are easily damaged.
primaryTranslation: 游客必须沿标记小路行走，因为几个区域生长着易受损的植物。

english: place where a person or a family lives
primaryExample: Their new home is close to the station, which makes visiting relatives much easier at weekends.
primaryTranslation: 他们的新家靠近车站，周末探望亲戚就方便多了。

english: not ever; not at any time
primaryExample: I had never used this kind of camera before, so I read the instructions before taking photographs.
primaryTranslation: 我以前从没用过这种相机，所以拍照前先读了说明书。

english: to make someone/something part of a group
primaryExample: The ticket price will include a guided tour, although visitors must pay separately for the practical workshop.
primaryTranslation: 票价将包含导览，但实践工作坊需要游客另外付费。

english: route or direction that a river, etc., moves along
primaryExample: The river changed its course after the storm, leaving part of the old walking path under water.
primaryTranslation: 暴风雨后河流改道，旧步道的一部分被淹在水下。

english: building in which a family, person lives
primaryExample: The house at the end of the lane has a garden that overlooks the entire valley.
primaryTranslation: 小巷尽头那栋房子的花园能俯瞰整个山谷。

english: account of something which gives the necessary facts and information
primaryExample: The report explains why the bridge needs repairs and suggests how the work could be completed safely.
primaryTranslation: 报告解释了桥为何需要维修，并建议如何安全完成施工。

english: number of people or things gathered together
primaryExample: Our group included several experienced walkers who helped the younger children cross the stream safely.
primaryTranslation: 我们组里有几位经验丰富的徒步者，帮助较小的孩子安全过溪。

english: example or instance of something
primaryExample: The missing delivery was an unusual case, because every other parcel had arrived at the correct address.
primaryTranslation: 这次投递丢失很不寻常，因为其他每个包裹都送对了地址。

english: adult female human being
primaryExample: The woman leading the workshop encouraged everyone to share a practical skill they had learned at home.
primaryTranslation: 主持工作坊的女士鼓励每个人分享一项在家学到的实用技能。

english: located on every side, or along something
primaryExample: There were benches all around the lake, so visitors could stop whenever they wanted to enjoy the view.
primaryTranslation: 湖的四周都有长椅，游客想欣赏景色时随时可以停下。

english: thing made of pages with writing on that you read
primaryExample: The book contains detailed maps and useful advice for people who prefer travelling without a tour guide.
primaryTranslation: 这本书包含详细地图和实用建议，供喜欢不跟导游旅行的人使用。

english: a group of people who are related through blood
primaryExample: Her family moved to the town last summer, but they have already become involved in several local activities.
primaryTranslation: 她家去年夏天搬到镇上，但他们已经参与了好几项当地活动。

english: to appear to be something
primaryExample: The instructions seem complicated at first, but the task becomes much simpler once you start practising.
primaryTranslation: 说明乍看很复杂，但一开始练习，任务就简单多了。

english: to not stop someone from doing something
primaryExample: The organisers will let us use the hall if we promise to leave everything clean afterwards.
primaryTranslation: 如果我们保证事后打扫干净，组织者就会允许我们使用大厅。

english: one more time, once more
primaryExample: We decided to visit the exhibition again because there had been too many people on our first visit.
primaryTranslation: 我们决定再看一次展览，因为第一次去的时候人太多了。

english: one type of thing
primaryExample: This kind of material is useful for outdoor furniture because it does not easily absorb water.
primaryTranslation: 这种材料适合制作户外家具，因为它不容易吸水。

english: to have and continue to hold something
primaryExample: You can keep the guidebook after the tour, so there is no need to return it.
primaryTranslation: 导览结束后你可以保留指南，不必归还。

english: to be aware of sound; to perceive with the ear
primaryExample: We could hear music coming from the square long before we saw the musicians standing there.
primaryTranslation: 还没看到站在广场上的音乐家，我们就远远听到了音乐。

english: set of organized, planned ideas that work together
primaryExample: The new booking system allows visitors to choose a time that suits them without calling the office.
primaryTranslation: 新的预订系统让游客无需打电话，就能选择适合自己的时间。

english: including each person or thing in a group
primaryExample: Every visitor received a reusable cup so that the festival would produce less waste than before.
primaryTranslation: 每位游客都得到一个可重复使用的杯子，让音乐节比以前产生更少垃圾。

english: to ask for or try to get information
primaryExample: The guide encouraged us to question the information on old maps rather than accept every detail as accurate.
primaryTranslation: 导游鼓励我们质疑旧地图上的信息，而不是认定所有细节都准确。

english: at some point in the course of an event or thing
primaryExample: We took notes during the demonstration because the instructor explained several techniques that were completely new to us.
primaryTranslation: 演示时我们做了笔记，因为教练讲了几种我们完全没接触过的技巧。

english: at all times; in every situation
primaryExample: The library always keeps a few tables free for visitors who have not been able to book.
primaryTranslation: 图书馆总会留几张空桌，给没能预约到的访客使用。

english: large
primaryExample: The new community hall is big enough to host concerts as well as regular classes and meetings.
primaryTranslation: 新社区大厅足够大，既能举办音乐会，也能开展常规课程和会议。

english: complete group of something (e.g., a chess set)
primaryExample: We bought a complete set of tools so that everyone could take part in the repair workshop.
primaryTranslation: 我们买了一套完整工具，让每个人都能参加维修工作坊。

english: little in size; not big
primaryExample: The village has a small library, but its collection includes books in several different languages.
primaryTranslation: 村里有一座小图书馆，但馆藏包括好几种语言的书。

english: to focus on learning something usually at school
primaryExample: We study local plants during our weekly walks, recording any changes that we notice throughout the year.
primaryTranslation: 我们在每周散步时研究当地植物，记录一年中注意到的各种变化。

english: to come after someone; be guided by someone
primaryExample: Please follow the guide closely because the path becomes narrow where it passes through the rocky area.
primaryTranslation: 请紧跟导游，因为小路经过岩石区时会变得狭窄。

english: to do the first part of an action; to start
primaryExample: The workshop will begin once everyone has found a seat and checked that their materials are complete.
primaryTranslation: 大家找到座位并核对材料齐全后，工作坊就会开始。

english: having a big effect on (person, the future)
primaryExample: It is important to check the route beforehand, especially when some members of the group are inexperienced.
primaryTranslation: 提前核查路线很重要，尤其是当组里有人缺乏经验时。

english: from the time in the past that
primaryExample: We have used the same meeting room since the club opened, although the building has changed considerably.
primaryTranslation: 俱乐部成立以来，我们一直用同一间会议室，尽管整栋楼变化很大。

english: to move your legs faster than walking
primaryExample: We usually run along the river before breakfast, when the paths are quiet and the air is cool.
primaryTranslation: 我们通常在早饭前沿河跑步，那时小路安静，空气凉爽。

english: in the same place as another thing, but lower
primaryExample: The spare chairs are under the stairs, where they can be stored without blocking the main entrance.
primaryTranslation: 备用椅子在楼梯下，可以存放在那里而不堵住正门。

english: to change the direction of something (e.g., a car)
primaryExample: The driver had to turn the bus around because the narrow road ahead was completely blocked.
primaryTranslation: 司机不得不把公交车掉头，因为前面的窄路完全堵住了。

english: not many; small in number
primaryExample: Few visitors realised that the small building behind the museum had once been the village school.
primaryTranslation: 很少有游客知道，博物馆后面的小楼曾是村里的学校。

english: to take or go with someone to a place
primaryExample: Please bring a notebook to the workshop so that you can record any ideas you want to try.
primaryTranslation: 请带笔记本来工作坊，方便记下你想尝试的点子。

english: happening sooner than expected
primaryExample: The early train was less crowded, which gave us plenty of space to sit together during the journey.
primaryTranslation: 早班火车没那么拥挤，路上我们有充足空间坐在一起。

english: body part at the end of a person's arm
primaryExample: She raised her hand to ask whether the group could visit the tower after the main tour.
primaryTranslation: 她举手询问，团队是否能在主要导览结束后参观塔楼。

english: region within a country, with its own government
primaryExample: The state government introduced new rules to protect the forests that attract visitors from neighbouring regions.
primaryTranslation: 州政府出台了新规定，保护那些吸引邻近地区游客的森林。

english: to cause something to change to a different place
primaryExample: We need to move the table closer to the window so that the photographs receive more natural light.
primaryTranslation: 我们得把桌子移近窗户，让照片得到更多自然光。

english: coins or notes we use to pay for things
primaryExample: We saved enough money for the trip by preparing meals at home instead of eating out.
primaryTranslation: 我们通过在家做饭而不是外出吃饭，攒够了旅行的钱。

english: something that is known or proved to be true
primaryExample: The guide checked every fact before publishing the booklet, because earlier editions had contained several mistakes.
primaryTranslation: 导游出版小册子前核实了每个事实，因为早先版本存在几处错误。

english: used to say something is different from what was said before; but
primaryExample: The route looked short on the map; however, several steep hills made the walk much more tiring.
primaryTranslation: 地图上的路线看起来很短，然而几座陡坡让徒步累了不少。

english: a specific section or space; part of a region
primaryExample: The area around the old station has become more popular since several independent shops opened there.
primaryTranslation: 老车站周边的地区自从开了几家独立商店后，越来越受欢迎。

english: to make available; to supply for use
primaryExample: The organisers provide all the necessary materials, so participants only need to bring their own notebooks.
primaryTranslation: 组织者提供全部必要材料，因此参与者只需自带笔记本。

english: what something or someone is called
primaryExample: Please write your name on the box so that nobody takes your materials home by mistake.
primaryTranslation: 请在盒子上写上姓名，以免有人误把你的材料带回家。

english: to look at and comprehend the meaning some writing
primaryExample: I usually read the instructions twice before using unfamiliar equipment, especially when several parts look similar.
primaryTranslation: 使用不熟悉的设备前，我通常读两遍说明，尤其是几个零件很相似时。

english: person who you like and enjoy being with
primaryExample: A friend who knows the city well offered to show us some places beyond the usual tourist routes.
primaryTranslation: 一位熟悉这座城市的朋友主动带我们去常规旅游路线之外的一些地方。

english: one of 12 time periods that make a year, each from 28 to 31 days long
primaryExample: The exhibition changes every month, giving regular visitors a reason to return and discover something different.
primaryTranslation: 展览每月更换，让常来的游客有理由回来发现不同的东西。

english: big; of great size; broad, tall, wide, long, or fat
primaryExample: The large windows allow plenty of daylight into the hall, reducing the need for artificial lighting.
primaryTranslation: 大窗户让充足日光进入大厅，减少了对人工照明的需求。

english: the making, buying, or selling goods or services for money
primaryExample: The family started a small business selling handmade furniture, which gradually attracted customers from other towns.
primaryTranslation: 这家人创办了一家销售手工家具的小企业，逐渐吸引了其他城镇的顾客。

english: used to say you don't have something or it isn't in a place
primaryExample: We managed to assemble the shelves without any help, although the instructions were not particularly clear.
primaryTranslation: 尽管说明不太清楚，我们还是在没人帮助的情况下装好了架子。

english: collection of facts and details about something
primaryExample: The website provides detailed information about walking routes, including their length and the facilities available nearby.
primaryTranslation: 网站提供详细的徒步路线信息，包括路线长度和附近可用设施。

english: not closed or shut
primaryExample: The garden remains open throughout the winter, although the small café only serves visitors at weekends.
primaryTranslation: 花园整个冬天都开放，但小咖啡馆仅在周末接待游客。

english: to ask for something you want to buy (e.g., a meal)
primaryExample: We decided to order lunch before visiting the gallery because the restaurant becomes busy after midday.
primaryTranslation: 我们决定参观画廊前先点午饭，因为餐馆中午以后会变忙。

english: group of people and system which rule a nation
primaryExample: The government announced plans to improve public transport in rural areas where bus services had recently been reduced.
primaryTranslation: 政府宣布计划改善公交班次近期减少的农村地区的公共交通。

english: unit of language that has a meaning
primaryExample: I understood every word in the sentence, but the expression as a whole still confused me.
primaryTranslation: 句子里的每个词我都懂，但整个表达仍让我困惑。

english: important topic discussed, debated, or argued over
primaryExample: The main issue at the meeting was how to keep the library open during the repairs.
primaryTranslation: 会议的主要议题是，如何在维修期间维持图书馆开放。

english: public event where people sell goods on tables
primaryExample: The weekly market attracts visitors who want fresh vegetables and products made by people from nearby villages.
primaryTranslation: 每周的集市吸引着想购买新鲜蔬菜和附近村民制作产品的游客。

english: to give money for goods or work done
primaryExample: Visitors can pay by card at the entrance, but the café only accepts cash during busy periods.
primaryTranslation: 游客可以在入口刷卡付款，但咖啡馆在繁忙时段只收现金。

english: to make (e.g., a house, by putting materials together)
primaryExample: The students helped build a wooden shelter where visitors could rest while exploring the nature reserve.
primaryTranslation: 学生们帮忙搭建了一个木棚，供游览自然保护区的游客休息。

english: to use hands or arms to carry or keep something
primaryExample: Please hold the ladder steady while I check whether the box on the top shelf is ours.
primaryTranslation: 我确认顶层架上的箱子是否属于我们时，请扶稳梯子。

english: to maintain a piece of machinery so it runs well
primaryExample: You should service the bicycle regularly if you want it to remain reliable throughout the winter.
primaryTranslation: 如果你想让自行车整个冬天都可靠，就应该定期保养它。

english: in opposition to; disagreeing with
primaryExample: Several residents spoke against the proposal because they believed it would make the narrow street less safe.
primaryTranslation: 几位居民发言反对这项提案，因为他们认为这会让狭窄街道更不安全。

english: to think or accept that something is true
primaryExample: I believe the project can succeed, provided that everyone understands their responsibilities and shares information regularly.
primaryTranslation: 我相信这个项目能成功，前提是每个人都清楚职责并定期共享信息。

english: 2nd; the one following first
primaryExample: Our second attempt was more successful because we had corrected the mistakes made during the first test.
primaryTranslation: 第二次尝试更成功，因为我们修正了第一次测试中的错误。

english: although, despite the fact that
primaryExample: The journey took longer than expected; the views from the mountain train made it worthwhile, though.
primaryTranslation: 旅程比预期更久，不过山间列车沿途的景色让它很值得。

english: way to say you agree or will do something
primaryExample: When the organiser asked whether we could stay a little longer, we said yes without any hesitation.
primaryTranslation: 组织者问我们能否多待一会儿时，我们毫不犹豫地答应了。

english: to care for and like someone very strong and deeply
primaryExample: Although they live far apart, the sisters love each other deeply and speak on the phone every evening.
primaryTranslation: 虽然姐妹俩相隔很远，但她们彼此深爱，每晚都打电话。

english: to make or become something larger in size or amount
primaryExample: The library plans to increase its opening hours so that people working late can borrow books more easily.
primaryTranslation: 图书馆计划延长开放时间，方便下班晚的人借书。

english: regular work of earning money
primaryExample: Her new job involves organising events for visitors who want to learn more about the region.
primaryTranslation: 她的新工作包括为想深入了解该地区的游客组织活动。

english: to decide a set of actions to do something
primaryExample: We need to plan the journey carefully because there are very few places to stop along the route.
primaryTranslation: 我们需要仔细规划行程，因为沿途可供停留的地方很少。

english: to be the outcome of other causes and effects
primaryExample: A lack of clear instructions can result in mistakes, even when the people involved are highly experienced.
primaryTranslation: 说明不清楚可能导致出错，即使参与者经验十分丰富。

english: not here; far from here; in a different direction
primaryExample: The nearest supermarket is several kilometres away, so we usually buy enough food for the whole week.
primaryTranslation: 最近的超市有几公里远，因此我们通常买够一周的食物。

english: something or someone who represents a group
primaryExample: The restored watermill is a fine example of the buildings that once supported life in this valley.
primaryTranslation: 修复后的水磨坊很好地代表了曾支撑这个山谷居民生活的建筑。

english: to take place or occur
primaryExample: If a delay does happen, the organiser will send a message explaining when the activity can begin.
primaryTranslation: 如果确实出现延误，组织者会发消息说明活动何时能开始。

english: to give the opportunity to accept something
primaryExample: The guide will offer advice on suitable walking routes before you set off into the hills.
primaryTranslation: 向山里出发前，导游会就合适的步行路线提供建议。

english: at an early stage of existence; not mature
primaryExample: The young trees need protection from strong winds until their roots have had enough time to develop.
primaryTranslation: 幼树需要避开强风，直到根系有充分时间发育。

english: next to; only a short distance away
primaryExample: We stood close to the guide so that we could hear her explanation above the street noise.
primaryTranslation: 我们站得离导游很近，以便在街道噪声中听清她的讲解。

english: planned set of actions; a schematic system
primaryExample: The training program combines practical tasks with discussion, helping new volunteers prepare for several different responsibilities.
primaryTranslation: 培训项目把实践任务和讨论结合起来，帮助新志愿者为几种不同职责作准备。

english: to show the way or guide others
primaryExample: An experienced volunteer will lead the group through the forest, stopping to explain how the landscape has changed.
primaryTranslation: 一位经验丰富的志愿者将带队穿越森林，并停下来解释地貌如何变化。

english: to get something by paying money for it
primaryExample: We decided to buy a reusable bottle because it would be more convenient during our walking holidays.
primaryTranslation: 我们决定买一个可重复使用的水瓶，因为徒步度假时会更方便。

english: to know the meaning of language, what someone says
primaryExample: Once you understand how the booking system works, you can reserve a room without asking for help.
primaryTranslation: 一旦明白预订系统如何运作，你就可以独立预订房间。

english: to tell someone you are grateful to them
primaryExample: I would like to thank everyone who stayed after the event to help us clear the hall.
primaryTranslation: 我要感谢活动结束后留下来帮我们清理大厅的所有人。

english: a long way away
primaryExample: The far end of the garden was too shady for vegetables, so we planted flowers there instead.
primaryTranslation: 花园远端过于阴暗，不适合种菜，因此我们改在那里种花。

english: on this day; at the time that is happening now
primaryExample: The town looks very different today because many old industrial buildings have been converted into homes and studios.
primaryTranslation: 如今镇上面貌很不一样，因为许多旧工业建筑被改成了住宅和工作室。

english: 60 minutes; one of 24 equal units of time in a day
primaryExample: The journey takes about an hour if the traffic is light, but much longer during the evening.
primaryTranslation: 交通顺畅时路程大约一小时，但晚间会长得多。

english: person studying at school
primaryExample: Every student was asked to explain their design before the class voted for the most practical solution.
primaryTranslation: 每个学生都要先解释自己的设计，然后全班投票选出最实用的方案。

english: front part of the head where eyes, nose, and mouth are
primaryExample: The cold wind made her face turn red while she waited outside the station for her friends.
primaryTranslation: 她在车站外等朋友时，寒风把她的脸吹红了。

english: when you wish something would happen; what you wish
primaryExample: Our hope is that the new garden will encourage neighbours to spend more time talking to each other.
primaryTranslation: 我们希望新花园能鼓励邻居们花更多时间相互交流。

english: belief, thought, suggestion, opinion, or plan
primaryExample: His idea for a shared tool collection could save neighbours money and reduce the amount they throw away.
primaryTranslation: 他提出共享工具的想法，既能帮邻居省钱，也能减少丢弃的物品。

english: price you pay for something
primaryExample: The cost of the repairs was higher than expected because several damaged parts had to be replaced.
primaryTranslation: 维修费用比预期高，因为几处损坏的零件必须更换。

english: smaller in amount or degree
primaryExample: The new lighting system uses less electricity while making the reading room noticeably brighter in the evening.
primaryTranslation: 新照明系统耗电更少，晚间阅览室却明显更亮了。

english: a part of building enclosed by walls (e.g., kitchen)
primaryExample: The room at the back of the house was quiet enough to use as a small office.
primaryTranslation: 房子后部的房间很安静，足以用作小办公室。

english: up to, to indicate a point in time when something happens
primaryExample: We waited until the rain stopped before leaving the café and continuing our walk along the coast.
primaryTranslation: 我们等到雨停后才离开咖啡馆，继续沿海岸步行。

english: explanation for why something occurred or was done
primaryExample: The main reason for choosing this route was that it offered safe paths away from busy roads.
primaryTranslation: 选择这条路线的主要原因，是它提供了远离繁忙道路的安全小路。

english: visible shape or style; type; kind
primaryExample: The painting gradually took the form of a landscape as she added the river and distant hills.
primaryTranslation: 随着她添上河流和远山，这幅画逐渐呈现出风景画的样子。

english: to use money to pay for something
primaryExample: We try to spend less on transport by walking whenever the weather and the distance allow it.
primaryTranslation: 只要天气和距离允许，我们就步行，尽量少花交通费。

english: top part of your body with eyes and a mouth
primaryExample: Wear a helmet to protect your head when you cycle, even if you are only travelling a short distance.
primaryTranslation: 骑车时请戴头盔保护头部，即使只走很短的距离。

english: a vehicle with four wheels and engine that can carry things
primaryExample: We left the car outside the village because the narrow streets were easier to explore on foot.
primaryTranslation: 我们把车停在村外，因为狭窄街道更适合步行游览。

english: to get knowledge or skills by study or experience
primaryExample: You can learn a great deal from other people's suggestions without agreeing with every opinion they express.
primaryTranslation: 即使不认同别人表达的每个观点，你仍能从他们的建议中学到很多。

english: to make things flat or even
primaryExample: We need to level the ground before building the shelter, otherwise the wooden floor will not fit properly.
primaryTranslation: 搭棚前我们需要平整地面，否则木地板无法妥善安装。

english: man, woman, or child
primaryExample: The person responsible for the booking should check the final numbers before confirming how many tickets are needed.
primaryTranslation: 负责预订的人应核对最终人数，再确认需要多少张票。

english: knowledge gained by living life, doing new things
primaryExample: Her experience of working with visitors helped her explain the complicated instructions in a clear and friendly way.
primaryTranslation: 她接待游客的经验，帮助她用清楚友好的方式讲解复杂说明。

english: one time; one instance
primaryExample: I have only visited the island once, but I still remember the sound of waves outside our window.
primaryTranslation: 我只去过那座岛一次，却仍记得窗外的海浪声。

english: person or thing belonging to a group or team
primaryExample: Each member of the group chose a different task so that the work could be completed efficiently.
primaryTranslation: 每个组员选择不同任务，使工作能够高效完成。

english: equal to what is needed; as much as required
primaryExample: We had enough food for everyone, although several extra guests arrived just before the meal began.
primaryTranslation: 虽然开饭前又来了几位客人，但食物仍足够所有人吃。

english: not good; wrong
primaryExample: The road was in bad condition after the winter, making the journey slower and less comfortable.
primaryTranslation: 过冬后路况很差，让旅途更慢也更不舒适。

english: a heavily populated area with many buildings and roads
primaryExample: The city has introduced more bicycle lanes to make travelling between residential areas and the centre safer.
primaryTranslation: 这座城市增设了自行车道，让住宅区与市中心之间的骑行更安全。

english: the time of time from when the sun goes down to when it comes up again
primaryExample: We stayed up late that night, discussing which places we should visit during the rest of our holiday.
primaryTranslation: 那天晚上我们聊到很晚，讨论假期剩下的时间该去哪些地方。

english: having the power, skill, knowledge, or money to do something
primaryExample: After a few lessons, she was able to repair the bicycle without needing help from her neighbour.
primaryTranslation: 上过几节课后，她就能不靠邻居帮助自己修自行车了。

english: to give assistance or advice to someone
primaryExample: The library will support new readers by offering weekly sessions where they can practise with experienced volunteers.
primaryTranslation: 图书馆将每周组织活动，让新读者和有经验的志愿者一起练习，为他们提供支持。

english: if something will happen or not
primaryExample: We have not decided whether to hold the event outdoors, because the weather forecast keeps changing.
primaryTranslation: 我们还没决定是否在户外办活动，因为天气预报不断变化。

english: mark that is long, straight, and very thin
primaryExample: Draw a straight line between the two points before you start measuring the angle on the diagram.
primaryTranslation: 先在两点之间画一条直线，再测量图上的角度。

english: gift
primaryExample: We chose a handmade present for our neighbour because she had spent so much time helping us move.
primaryTranslation: 我们为邻居选了一份手工礼物，因为她花了很多时间帮我们搬家。

english: straight edge of an object
primaryExample: Write the measurements along each side of the rectangle so that everyone can check the diagram easily.
primaryTranslation: 请沿矩形各边标注尺寸，方便大家核查图示。

english: very; in a complete or total manner
primaryExample: The instructions were quite clear, but a practical demonstration helped everyone understand the more difficult steps.
primaryTranslation: 说明很清楚，但一次实际演示帮助大家理解了较难的步骤。

english: despite the fact that; however
primaryExample: Although the room was small, careful planning allowed us to fit everything we needed along one wall.
primaryTranslation: 虽然房间很小，仔细规划后我们仍把所需的一切沿一面墙放下了。

english: having no doubts about something
primaryExample: I am sure the parcel arrived yesterday because I remember signing for it shortly before lunch.
primaryTranslation: 我确定包裹昨天到了，因为我记得午饭前不久签收了它。

english: fixed period of weeks for learning at school
primaryExample: The school will offer a new photography course next term if enough students express an interest.
primaryTranslation: 如果足够多的学生感兴趣，学校下学期将开设一门新摄影课。

english: in the smallest or lowest way
primaryExample: Of all the rooms we visited, the smallest one was the least expensive and surprisingly comfortable.
primaryTranslation: 我们看过的所有房间中，最小的那间价格最低，而且出乎意料地舒适。

english: number of years a person has lived (also of things)
primaryExample: Children under the age of twelve must stay with an adult while exploring the upper floors.
primaryTranslation: 十二岁以下的孩子游览楼上时，必须有成人陪同。

english: not high; being near the ground, or bottom
primaryExample: The low wall around the garden was easy to step over, so we added a small fence.
primaryTranslation: 花园周围的矮墙很容易跨过去，所以我们又加了一道小围栏。

english: to use words to tell information, express thoughts
primaryExample: Please speak slowly during the demonstration so that visitors who are learning English can follow your explanation.
primaryTranslation: 演示时请慢慢说，让正在学英语的游客能听懂你的讲解。

chinese: 在..（空间，时间或范围）之内
english: not beyond the limits of a particular space, time, or range
primaryExample: You should receive a reply within three working days, unless we need additional information about your request.
primaryTranslation: 除非我们需要与你的请求相关的补充信息，否则你应在三个工作日内收到答复。

english: to adopt a set of actions that produce a particular result
primaryExample: The office will process your application once all the necessary documents have been checked and approved.
primaryTranslation: 所有必要文件核对并获批后，办公室将处理你的申请。

english: concerning society in general
primaryExample: The council asked for public feedback before deciding whether to make permanent changes to the main square.
primaryTranslation: 市政会在决定是否永久改造主广场前，征求了公众反馈。

english: many times, frequently, on many occasions
primaryExample: We often discuss difficult tasks before starting, because sharing ideas can save time and prevent mistakes.
primaryTranslation: 我们常在开始前讨论难题，因为分享想法能节省时间并避免错误。

english: vehicle that carries people and runs on rails
primaryExample: We caught an earlier train so that we could visit the market before meeting our friends for lunch.
primaryTranslation: 我们赶了更早的火车，以便和朋友吃午饭前先逛集市。

english: having a chance of happening, or being true
primaryExample: It may be possible to extend the visit if everyone agrees and the building remains open late.
primaryTranslation: 如果大家同意且建筑继续开放到较晚，参观时间或许可以延长。

english: used to add new (often different) information
primaryExample: I thought the museum was expensive, but admission is actually free for visitors under eighteen years old.
primaryTranslation: 我原以为博物馆很贵，但十八岁以下游客其实可以免费入场。

chinese: 或多或少地；相当地；稍微
english: somewhat; fairly; not that much
primaryExample: The room felt rather warm after the workshop, so we opened the windows while everyone took a break.
primaryTranslation: 工作坊结束后房间有点热，于是趁大家休息时我们打开了窗户。

english: things you are able to see from a specific place
primaryExample: The view from the tower was worth the climb, even though the narrow stairs had been tiring.
primaryTranslation: 尽管爬狭窄楼梯很累，塔上看到的景色还是值得一看。

english: near close in the same place not far in a family or group
primaryExample: We worked together to repair the old benches, sharing tools and learning useful skills from our neighbours.
primaryTranslation: 我们一起修理旧长椅，共享工具，也向邻居学习实用技能。

english: to think carefully about something
primaryExample: We should consider the needs of younger visitors before deciding how long the guided walk should last.
primaryTranslation: 决定导览步行持续多久之前，我们应该考虑年幼游客的需要。

english: to determine or set the cost of something
primaryExample: The artist decided to price the smaller pictures reasonably so that more visitors could afford to buy them.
primaryTranslation: 画家决定给小幅画作定一个合理价格，让更多游客买得起。

primaryCollocations.chinese: 为产品制定有竞争力的价格

english: person's mother or father
primaryExample: Every parent received a message explaining what their child should bring for the school trip next week.
primaryTranslation: 每位家长都收到了消息，说明孩子下周学校旅行应该带什么。

english: difficult to bend, break or cut; solid
primaryExample: The wood was too hard to cut with our small tools, so we borrowed a stronger saw.
primaryTranslation: 木头太硬，我们的小工具切不开，所以借了一把更结实的锯子。

english: social event often with food, drinks, and dancing
primaryExample: We organised a small party for the volunteers who had helped restore the community garden over the summer.
primaryTranslation: 我们为整个夏天帮助修复社区花园的志愿者办了一场小聚会。

english: relating or restricted to a particular area, city, or town
primaryExample: The guide recommended a local bakery where we could buy fresh bread before starting our morning walk.
primaryTranslation: 导游推荐了一家当地面包店，让我们能在晨间徒步前买新鲜面包。

english: to direct or influence the behavior of something
primaryExample: The new system helps staff control the temperature in each room without wasting energy in empty areas.
primaryTranslation: 新系统帮助员工控制各房间的温度，避免在空置区域浪费能源。

english: having happened or been done before this time
primaryExample: We had already booked our tickets when we discovered that the concert would take place outdoors.
primaryTranslation: 发现音乐会将在户外举行时，我们已经订好票了。

english: feeling of worry or anxiety
primaryExample: Her main concern was whether the children would have enough time to eat before the performance began.
primaryTranslation: 她主要担心的是孩子们在演出开始前是否有足够时间吃饭。

english: item that can be bought
primaryExample: The shop lets customers test each product before buying, which makes choosing unfamiliar equipment much easier.
primaryTranslation: 商店允许顾客购买前试用每件产品，让挑选不熟悉的设备容易多了。

english: to be unable to find something you once had
primaryExample: Keep the tickets in the same pocket so that you do not lose them during the journey.
primaryTranslation: 请把票放在同一个口袋里，以免途中丢失。

english: an account or description of how something happened
primaryExample: The guide told a story about the family who had built the house and planted its unusual garden.
primaryTranslation: 导游讲述了建造这栋房子并种植独特花园的那家人的故事。

english: only a little less than, nearly, not quite
primaryExample: The workshop was almost full when we arrived, but the organiser managed to find us two seats.
primaryTranslation: 我们到达时工作坊几乎满员，但组织者还是给我们找到了两个座位。

english: to do something without stopping, or after pausing
primaryExample: We decided to continue the discussion after lunch because several useful suggestions still needed to be considered.
primaryTranslation: 我们决定午饭后继续讨论，因为还有几个有用建议需要考虑。

english: to be upright; not be sitting or lying down
primaryExample: We had to stand near the back of the hall because all the seats were already taken.
primaryTranslation: 我们不得不站在大厅后部附近，因为座位已经全满了。

english: complete or full; all of
primaryExample: The whole village helped prepare the festival, from decorating the square to welcoming visitors at the station.
primaryTranslation: 整个村子都帮忙筹备节日，从装饰广场到在车站迎接游客。

english: until now; up to the present
primaryExample: We have not received the final timetable yet, so we cannot confirm when the workshop will finish.
primaryTranslation: 我们还没收到最终时间表，因此无法确认工作坊何时结束。

english: speed or frequency of events over time
primaryExample: The rate at which the plants grew surprised everyone, especially after several weeks of cold weather.
primaryTranslation: 植物生长的速度让大家吃惊，尤其是在经历几周寒冷天气之后。

english: to look after someone or something
primaryExample: The volunteers care for the garden throughout the year, even when very few visitors come in winter.
primaryTranslation: 志愿者全年照料花园，即使冬天很少有游客前来。

english: to believe something is probably going to happen
primaryExample: We expect the repairs to finish next month, provided that all the necessary materials arrive on time.
primaryTranslation: 如果所有必要材料按时到货，我们预计维修下个月结束。

english: change brought about by a cause; result
primaryExample: The new lighting had an immediate effect on the room, making it feel larger and more welcoming.
primaryTranslation: 新照明立刻改变了房间，让它显得更宽敞、更亲切。

english: group or class of similar things or people
primaryExample: This sort of map is particularly useful for walkers because it shows paths that ordinary road maps omit.
primaryTranslation: 这种地图对徒步者特别实用，因为它标出了普通公路地图省略的小路。

english: at any time; at all times in the future
primaryExample: Have you ever visited a place that looked completely different from the photographs you had seen beforehand?
primaryTranslation: 你是否到过一个地方，发现它和事先看到的照片完全不一样？

english: thing of any kind; used to refer to a thing in questions
primaryExample: Please ask if there is anything you do not understand before you begin using the new equipment.
primaryTranslation: 开始使用新设备前，有任何不理解的地方请提问。

english: to make something happen; create effect or result
primaryExample: Leaving the windows open overnight could cause problems if the temperature falls below freezing before morning.
primaryTranslation: 如果天亮前气温降到冰点以下，整晚开窗可能会引发问题。

english: dropping from a standing position to the ground
primaryExample: A fall on the wet steps left him with a sore ankle, so we changed our walking plans.
primaryTranslation: 他在湿台阶上摔了一跤，脚踝疼痛，于是我们更改了徒步计划。

english: to give out (cards, etc.) to; distribute
primaryExample: Please deal the cards evenly while I explain the rules to the people who have never played before.
primaryTranslation: 我向没玩过的人解释规则时，请把牌均匀发给大家。

english: clear liquid that forms the seas, rivers, and rain
primaryExample: We carried extra water because there were no shops or public taps along the route we had chosen.
primaryTranslation: 我们多带了水，因为所选路线沿途没有商店或公共水龙头。

english: to cause mail or package to go to another place
primaryExample: Please send the updated timetable to everyone who registered, even if they have already received an earlier version.
primaryTranslation: 请把更新的时间表发给所有报名者，即使他们已收到早期版本。

english: to let or permit someone do something
primaryExample: The new arrangement will allow visitors to explore the gardens while the main building remains closed for repairs.
primaryTranslation: 新的安排将允许游客在主楼因维修关闭期间游览花园。

english: at a time not long from now
primaryExample: The museum will reopen soon, although visitors will have to book tickets before entering the smaller galleries.
primaryTranslation: 博物馆很快重新开放，但游客进入较小展厅前需要订票。

english: to look at carefully to work out what is happening
primaryExample: We stopped to watch the workers repair the roof, carefully replacing each damaged tile by hand.
primaryTranslation: 我们停下来观看工人修屋顶，他们正小心地手工替换每一块破瓦。

english: origin or start from which something came
primaryExample: The old farmhouse became our base for exploring the valley because several walking routes started nearby.
primaryTranslation: 老农舍成了我们探索山谷的据点，因为几条步行路线从附近开始。

english: likely to happen or be true
primaryExample: We will probably need a larger vehicle, since several people have offered to bring extra equipment.
primaryTranslation: 我们可能需要一辆更大的车，因为几个人主动提出带额外设备。

english: to mention something that could be done; propose
primaryExample: Could you suggest a quieter café where our group could discuss the project without disturbing other customers?
primaryTranslation: 你能推荐一家安静些的咖啡馆，让我们讨论项目又不打扰其他顾客吗？

english: the time that existed before now (e.g., long ago)
primaryExample: The exhibition explores the village's past through photographs and objects donated by families who still live nearby.
primaryTranslation: 展览通过仍住在附近的家庭捐赠的照片和物品，探索村庄的过去。

english: legal or official right to perform certain actions
primaryExample: The committee has the power to approve small repairs, but larger changes need permission from the council.
primaryTranslation: 委员会有权批准小修，但较大的改动需要市政会许可。

english: examination; questions to measure knowledge
primaryExample: The test includes practical tasks as well as written questions, allowing students to demonstrate several different skills.
primaryTranslation: 这项测验既有实践任务也有书面题，让学生展示几种不同技能。

english: to go to a place for a time, usually for a reason
primaryExample: We plan to visit the museum before lunch, when the galleries are usually less crowded and easier to explore.
primaryTranslation: 我们计划午饭前参观博物馆，那时展厅通常人少，更便于游览。

english: place in the middle of something
primaryExample: The fountain stands in the center of the square, providing a convenient meeting point for visitors.
primaryTranslation: 喷泉位于广场中央，为游客提供了方便的会合地点。

english: to develop and become bigger or taller over time
primaryExample: The plants grow more quickly near the window, where they receive natural light throughout the morning.
primaryTranslation: 植物在窗边长得更快，因为那里整个上午都有自然光。

english: not anything, not a single thing
primaryExample: There was nothing we could do until the replacement part arrived, so we started another task.
primaryTranslation: 替换零件到货前我们无事可做，所以开始了另一项任务。

english: to come back to a place again
primaryExample: We agreed to return to the village next summer, when the restored gardens would be open again.
primaryTranslation: 我们约定明年夏天再回村里，那时修复后的花园会重新开放。

english: a female who has a child or children
primaryExample: Her mother taught her to repair clothes, a skill that has saved the family money for years.
primaryTranslation: 她母亲教她修补衣服，这项技能多年来为家里省了钱。

english: to move with your legs at a slowish pace
primaryExample: We decided to walk along the river instead of taking the bus, since the weather had improved.
primaryTranslation: 天气好转了，我们决定沿河步行，而不坐公交车。

english: problem or reason for concern
primaryExample: The missing keys were a serious matter because nobody else could open the cupboard containing the equipment.
primaryTranslation: 钥匙丢失是个严重问题，因为没有其他人能打开存放设备的橱柜。

english: part of humans that allows us to think or feel
primaryExample: The workshop encouraged us to keep an open mind when listening to suggestions that challenged our usual approach.
primaryTranslation: 工作坊鼓励我们在听取挑战惯常方法的建议时保持开放心态。

english: to say how much money something is worth
primaryExample: An expert will value the old furniture before the family decides whether to keep it or sell it.
primaryTranslation: 家里决定保留还是出售旧家具前，将由专家先估价。

english: building of set of rooms used to do business or professional activities
primaryExample: The office is closed on Fridays, but staff can still answer urgent questions through the shared email account.
primaryTranslation: 办公室周五关闭，但员工仍可通过共享邮箱答复紧急问题。

english: being the highest or most extreme level achieved in an area
primaryExample: The team set a new record by completing the route faster than anyone had managed the previous year.
primaryTranslation: 团队比上一年所有人都更快地走完路线，创下了新纪录。

english: to spend time visiting a place or someone's home
primaryExample: We decided to stay at a small guesthouse where the owners could recommend walks away from busy tourist areas.
primaryTranslation: 我们决定住一家小旅馆，店主能推荐远离繁忙景点的步行路线。

english: to use physical strength or violence to persuade
primaryExample: The strong wind could force the gate open unless we secured it with a heavier metal latch.
primaryTranslation: 除非用更坚固的金属门闩锁好，否则强风可能把门强行吹开。

english: to finish moving or to come to an end
primaryExample: We had to stop beside the road because a fallen tree was blocking the narrow entrance to the village.
primaryTranslation: 我们不得不停在路边，因为倒下的树挡住了通往村子的狭窄入口。

english: more than two but not many
primaryExample: Several visitors asked for a longer tour because they wanted more time to examine the unusual paintings.
primaryTranslation: 几位游客要求延长导览，因为他们想多花些时间仔细看那些独特画作。

english: not heavy; weighing only a little
primaryExample: The new tent is light enough to carry comfortably, even when we also need food and extra clothing.
primaryTranslation: 新帐篷很轻，即使还要带食物和备用衣物，背起来也很轻松。

english: to grow bigger, more complex, or more advanced
primaryExample: Children can develop practical skills by helping with simple projects that require careful planning and teamwork.
primaryTranslation: 孩子们可以通过参与需要仔细规划和团队合作的简单项目，培养实用技能。

english: to bring a previous image or idea to your mind
primaryExample: Please remember where you put the spare key, because the office will be closed when we return.
primaryTranslation: 请记住备用钥匙放在哪里，因为我们回来时办公室会关门。

english: small piece of something
primaryExample: There was a bit of bread left after lunch, so we saved it to make soup later.
primaryTranslation: 午饭后剩了一点面包，所以我们留着稍后做汤。

english: part of a company you own, shown by a certificate
primaryExample: Each share gives its owner a small stake in the company, although its value can change over time.
primaryTranslation: 每股股票让持有者拥有公司的一小部分权益，但股值会随时间变化。

english: actually existing or happening, not imagined
primaryExample: Working on a real project helped the students understand problems that classroom exercises had never shown them.
primaryTranslation: 参与真实项目，帮助学生理解了课堂练习从未呈现的问题。

english: solution to a problem or test question
primaryExample: We compared our answers after the test and discovered that several questions could be understood in different ways.
primaryTranslation: 考试后我们对比答案，发现几道题可以有不同理解。

english: to be in a resting position on a chair
primaryExample: We chose to sit near the window so that we could watch the boats while waiting for lunch.
primaryTranslation: 我们选择坐在窗边，等午饭时可以看船。

english: to understand after thinking; work out
primaryExample: We need to figure out why the drawer keeps sticking before we replace any of its parts.
primaryTranslation: 更换抽屉任何零件前，我们需要弄清它为何总是卡住。

english: message you put in an envelope and send by post
primaryExample: The letter explained why the delivery had been delayed and gave us a new date for its arrival.
primaryTranslation: 信中解释了投递为何延误，并告知新的到货日期。

english: to make a choice about something or choose after thinking
primaryExample: We should decide which tasks are most urgent before asking the volunteers to choose what they want to do.
primaryTranslation: 让志愿者选择想做的事之前，我们应该决定哪些任务最紧迫。

english: words or signs used to communicate messages
primaryExample: Learning another language can make travelling more enjoyable because everyday conversations become easier and more meaningful.
primaryTranslation: 学习另一种语言能让旅行更愉快，因为日常交谈会更轻松、更有意义。

english: the person, or thing that is being talked, or written about
primaryExample: The photographer chose the old bridge as her main subject because its shape changed with the light.
primaryTranslation: 摄影师把老桥选为主要拍摄对象，因为它的形态会随光线变化。

english: rank or level in society, ranked from high (rich professional people) to low (ordinary people)
primaryExample: The exhibition explores how social class affected the homes, jobs and education available to people in the past.
primaryTranslation: 展览探讨了过去社会阶层如何影响人们的住房、工作和受教育机会。

english: act or process of growing bigger or more advanced
primaryExample: The development of new paths has made the nature reserve easier to explore without damaging sensitive areas.
primaryTranslation: 新步道的建设，让人们更容易游览自然保护区，又不损害脆弱区域。

english: small city
primaryExample: The town becomes much busier during the summer, when visitors arrive to explore the nearby lakes.
primaryTranslation: 夏季游客来到附近湖区游览时，镇上会热闹得多。

english: the part you get when one is divided into two; ½
primaryExample: Half of the group stayed to finish the painting while the others went to collect more supplies.
primaryTranslation: 一半组员留下完成粉刷，其余人去领取更多用品。

english: unit of time equal to 60 seconds
primaryExample: Please wait a minute while I check whether the smaller meeting room is still available this afternoon.
primaryTranslation: 请稍等一分钟，我查一下那间小会议室今天下午是否还空着。

english: what people and animals eat to live
primaryExample: We brought enough food for the journey because the small cafés along the route might be closed.
primaryTranslation: 我们为旅程带足了食物，因为沿途小咖啡馆可能关门。

english: to separate into pieces by force, or by dropping
primaryExample: Be careful not to break the thin glass when you remove it from the wooden frame.
primaryTranslation: 把薄玻璃从木框中取出时，小心不要弄碎。

english: easy to understand; well-explained; obvious
primaryExample: The diagram made the instructions clear, especially for people who found the written explanation difficult to follow.
primaryTranslation: 示意图让说明变得清晰，尤其帮助了那些难以理解文字解释的人。

english: time that is to come after the present
primaryExample: The committee will discuss the future of the building before deciding whether to repair or replace it.
primaryTranslation: 委员会将讨论这栋楼的未来用途，再决定修缮还是重建。

english: one of two (used when there is a choice of two)
primaryExample: Either route will take us to the station, but the path beside the river is more pleasant.
primaryTranslation: 两条路线都通往车站，但河边那条小路更舒适。

english: at a specified length of time in the past
primaryExample: We visited the island several years ago, before the new bridge made travelling there much easier.
primaryTranslation: 我们几年前去过那座岛，那时新桥还没有让交通变得更方便。

english: for each; during each
primaryExample: The workshop costs twenty pounds per person, including all the materials needed to complete a small project.
primaryTranslation: 工作坊每人收费二十英镑，包括完成一个小项目所需的全部材料。

english: to be left behind, to continue to exist
