primaryExample: Several questions remain after the presentation, so the speaker has agreed to send us additional information.
primaryTranslation: 讲解后还有几个问题没解决，因此讲者答应发给我们补充信息。

english: highest or upper part or point of something
primaryExample: We climbed to the top of the tower, where the guide pointed out landmarks across the valley.
primaryTranslation: 我们爬到塔顶，导游在那里指出山谷各处的地标。

english: in the center of some things; in relation to several things
primaryExample: The old cottage was hidden among tall trees, which made it difficult to find from the road.
primaryTranslation: 老村舍藏在高树之间，从路上很难发现。

english: to succeed in a game or contest
primaryExample: The team hoped to win the final match, although their opponents had played extremely well throughout the season.
primaryTranslation: 球队希望赢得决赛，尽管对手整个赛季都表现极佳。

english: the quality of things you can see (e.g., red, blue)
primaryExample: We chose a lighter color for the walls so that the narrow room would feel more spacious.
primaryTranslation: 我们给墙壁选了浅一些的颜色，让狭窄房间显得更宽敞。

english: to have or be included as a part of something
primaryExample: The activity will involve some walking, so participants should wear comfortable shoes and bring water with them.
primaryTranslation: 活动会包含一些步行，因此参与者应穿舒适的鞋并带水。

english: to come to or arrive at a goal or destination
primaryExample: We should reach the village before sunset if we follow the shorter path through the woods.
primaryTranslation: 如果走穿过树林的较短路线，我们应该能在日落前到村里。

english: involving activities among people especially free time activities
primaryExample: The club organises social events as well as classes, giving newcomers a chance to make local friends.
primaryTranslation: 俱乐部除了开课还组织社交活动，让新来的人有机会结识本地朋友。

english: set amount of time during which events take place
primaryExample: The garden will close for a short period while workers replace the damaged path near the entrance.
primaryTranslation: 工人更换入口附近受损步道期间，花园会短暂关闭。

english: from one side to the other of something
primaryExample: The children watched the ferry travel across, then waited for it to return from the opposite bank.
primaryTranslation: 孩子们看着渡船驶到对岸，再等它从那边返回。

english: to make mention of something; to make a remark
primaryExample: Please note that the final bus leaves earlier on Sundays, so visitors should check their return journey carefully.
primaryTranslation: 请注意，周日末班车发车较早，所以游客要仔细核对返程安排。

english: study of past event
primaryExample: Studying local history helped us understand why the village had grown around the river rather than the road.
primaryTranslation: 研究地方历史帮助我们理解，村庄为何沿河流而非道路发展。

english: to make, cause, or bring into existence
primaryExample: The workshop encourages children to create useful objects from materials that would otherwise be thrown away.
primaryTranslation: 工作坊鼓励孩子们用原本会被丢弃的材料制作实用物品。

english: to control a vehicle so that it moves somewhere
primaryExample: We decided to drive along the coast because the main road was closed for repairs that weekend.
primaryTranslation: 我们决定沿海岸开车，因为那个周末主路封闭维修。

english: at a point on a line
primaryExample: Several benches stand along the river path, allowing walkers to stop and enjoy the view whenever they like.
primaryTranslation: 河边小路沿途有几张长椅，徒步者随时可以停下欣赏风景。

english: group of things or people sharing common features
primaryExample: This type of bicycle is suitable for city journeys, but it may be uncomfortable on rough country paths.
primaryTranslation: 这种自行车适合城市出行，但在崎岖乡间小路上可能不舒适。

english: waves traveling in air or water that can be heard
primaryExample: The sound of water running under the bridge became louder as we approached the narrow valley.
primaryTranslation: 我们走近狭窄山谷时，桥下流水声越来越大。

english: part of the body that you see with
primaryExample: The bright sunlight hurt my eyes, so I moved into the shade before looking at the map.
primaryTranslation: 强烈阳光刺得我眼睛难受，于是我先移到阴凉处再看地图。

english: sounds that are sung or played to give pleasure
primaryExample: The festival introduced us to music from several countries that we had never heard performed live before.
primaryTranslation: 音乐节让我们接触到几个国家的音乐，此前从没听过这些音乐的现场演出。

english: activity with rules that people play to have fun
primaryExample: The game encouraged children to share information because no single player had all the clues needed to finish.
primaryTranslation: 这款游戏鼓励孩子们共享信息，因为没有谁独自掌握完成游戏所需的全部线索。

english: concerning government or public affairs
primaryExample: The exhibition explains how political decisions changed the town's buildings and influenced the lives of ordinary residents.
primaryTranslation: 展览解释了政治决策如何改变镇上的建筑，并影响普通居民的生活。

english: costing no money
primaryExample: Admission is free on the first Sunday of each month, although visitors still need to reserve tickets online.
primaryTranslation: 每月第一个周日免费入场，但游客仍需网上预约门票。

english: to get something that someone has given or sent to you
primaryExample: You should receive a confirmation message shortly after booking, so please check that your email address is correct.
primaryTranslation: 预订后不久你应该会收到确认消息，因此请检查邮箱地址是否正确。

english: very short or brief period of time
primaryExample: For a moment, everyone stopped talking and listened to the unusual sound coming from the old clock.
primaryTranslation: 有那么一瞬间，大家停止交谈，听着老钟发出的奇怪声音。

english: giving something for money; the amount sold
primaryExample: The sale of handmade postcards helped raise enough money to buy new materials for the children's workshop.
primaryTranslation: 销售手工明信片筹到了足够资金，为儿童工作坊购买新材料。

english: course of action proposed by an organization, etc.
primaryExample: The museum changed its booking policy after visitors said they needed more flexibility when planning family trips.
primaryTranslation: 游客表示安排家庭出游需要更大灵活性后，博物馆更改了预订政策。

english: extra; in addition
primaryExample: We need further information about the route before deciding whether it is suitable for younger children.
primaryTranslation: 决定路线是否适合年幼孩子之前，我们需要更多相关信息。

english: a person's physical self
primaryExample: Stretching after a long journey can help your body feel more comfortable before you begin walking again.
primaryTranslation: 长途旅行后伸展一下身体，能让你再次步行前舒服一些。

english: to need something, to make it necessary
primaryExample: The practical workshop will require comfortable shoes because participants spend much of the session standing and moving around.
primaryTranslation: 实践工作坊要求穿舒适的鞋，因为参与者大部分时间要站着和走动。

english: to spend time until an expected thing happens
primaryExample: We decided to wait inside the café until the guide arrived, rather than stand outside in the rain.
primaryTranslation: 我们决定在咖啡馆里等导游，而不站在外面淋雨。

english: widespread, normal or usual
primaryExample: The first part of the course provides general advice before later sessions focus on more specific practical tasks.
primaryTranslation: 课程第一部分提供一般性建议，后面的课再集中讲更具体的实践任务。

english: to be seen, become visible; come into sight
primaryExample: Small flowers begin to appear beside the path in spring, even before the trees have grown new leaves.
primaryTranslation: 春天树木尚未长出新叶时，小花就开始出现在路旁。

english: facing or moving in the direction of something
primaryExample: We walked toward the harbour, where the guide had arranged for us to visit a fishing boat.
primaryTranslation: 我们朝港口走去，导游已安排我们在那里参观一艘渔船。

english: group of people working on a task together
primaryExample: Our team includes people with different skills, which helps us solve practical problems from several different angles.
primaryTranslation: 我们团队成员各有所长，帮助我们从多个角度解决实际问题。

english: not hard to do; not difficult
primaryExample: The route looks easy on the map, but several steep sections can be tiring for inexperienced walkers.
primaryTranslation: 地图上这条路线看似容易，但几段陡坡会让经验不足的徒步者很累。

english: single person, looked at separately from others
primaryExample: Each individual in the group received a separate task before everyone came together to discuss their results.
primaryTranslation: 组里每个人先分到一项独立任务，然后大家聚在一起讨论结果。

english: containing or holding as much as possible
primaryExample: The bus was already full when it reached our stop, so we had to wait for the next one.
primaryTranslation: 公交车到我们这站时已经满了，所以我们只能等下一班。

english: color of the sky on a dark night
primaryExample: The black cover protected the equipment from sunlight while making it harder to spot against the dark wall.
primaryTranslation: 黑色外罩让设备避开阳光，但靠着深色墙壁时也更难被发现。

english: to perceive using sight, sound, taste touch or hearing
primaryExample: She could sense a change in the atmosphere when the conversation moved from travel plans to family problems.
primaryTranslation: 话题从旅行计划转到家庭问题时，她能感觉到气氛变了。

english: possibly, but not certainly; maybe
primaryExample: Perhaps we should contact the museum before leaving, because its opening hours sometimes change during the holidays.
primaryTranslation: 也许出发前该联系博物馆，因为它的开放时间在假期有时会变。

english: to put two things or numbers together (e.g., 2+2)
primaryExample: Please add the dates to the shared calendar so that everyone knows when the equipment will be unavailable.
primaryTranslation: 请把日期加进共享日历，让大家知道设备何时不可使用。

english: statement that says how things should be
primaryExample: The main rule is that visitors must stay on the path to avoid damaging the plants nearby.
primaryTranslation: 主要规定是游客必须沿步道行走，以免损伤附近植物。

english: to travel through or near a place
primaryExample: We will pass the old watermill on our way to the village, so there will be time for photographs.
primaryTranslation: 去村里的路上我们会经过老水磨坊，因此会有时间拍照。

english: to manufacture something using machines
primaryExample: The factory can produce smaller batches, which allows local businesses to order only what they really need.
primaryTranslation: 工厂能小批量生产，让当地企业只订购真正需要的数量。

english: to exchange something for money
primaryExample: The village shop plans to sell more locally made products so that visitors can support nearby businesses.
primaryTranslation: 村里的商店计划销售更多本地产品，让游客支持附近企业。

english: small distance from one end to the other
primaryExample: We chose the short route through the park because the children were tired after visiting the museum.
primaryTranslation: 参观博物馆后孩子们累了，所以我们选了穿过公园的短路线。

english: to have the same opinion as someone else
primaryExample: We agree that the garden needs more seating, but we have different ideas about where to put it.
primaryTranslation: 我们都认为花园需要更多座位，但对摆放位置有不同想法。

english: system or rules made by the government
primaryExample: The new law requires businesses to provide clearer information about the cost of cancelling a booking.
primaryTranslation: 新法律要求企业更清楚地说明取消预订的费用。

english: all of the things mentioned
primaryExample: Before leaving the workshop, please check that everything you borrowed has been returned to the correct cupboard.
primaryTranslation: 离开工作坊前，请检查借用的所有东西是否都已放回正确的橱柜。

english: to carefully study to find and report new knowledge
primaryExample: The students will research the history of the bridge before designing an exhibition about its importance to the village.
primaryTranslation: 学生们将研究桥的历史，再设计展览说明它对村庄的重要性。

english: thing you put over something to close or hide it
primaryExample: The waterproof cover kept our bags dry even when heavy rain started during the walk back.
primaryTranslation: 即使返程徒步时下起大雨，防水罩也让我们的包保持干燥。

english: pages of a book are made from this
primaryExample: We used recycled paper for the invitations because the event was intended to encourage more environmentally responsible choices.
primaryTranslation: 我们用再生纸制作邀请函，因为活动旨在鼓励更环保的选择。

english: specific location where someone or something is
primaryExample: The position of the table near the window made it easier to examine the small objects carefully.
primaryTranslation: 桌子靠窗的位置让人更容易仔细观察小物件。

english: with a small distance between things
primaryExample: The near end of the platform was crowded, but there was plenty of space beside the last carriage.
primaryTranslation: 站台近端很拥挤，但最后一节车厢旁有很多空间。

english: a person; a man, woman or child
primaryExample: Every human needs opportunities to rest, especially after spending a long time concentrating on difficult tasks.
primaryTranslation: 每个人都需要休息机会，尤其是在长时间专注于困难任务后。

english: a machine for storing information and accessing the internet
primaryExample: The computer stores our bookings in one place, making it easier to find details when visitors call.
primaryTranslation: 电脑集中储存预订记录，方便游客来电时查找详情。

english: condition, location or position
primaryExample: The situation improved once we agreed on a clear plan and made sure everyone understood their responsibilities.
primaryTranslation: 我们确定清晰计划，并确保每个人理解职责后，情况就改善了。

english: employees of a company
primaryExample: The staff helped us find a quieter room where we could discuss the project without disturbing other visitors.
primaryTranslation: 工作人员帮我们找到一间安静些的房间，让我们讨论项目而不打扰其他访客。

english: an action or task (e.g., sports, washing your clothes)
primaryExample: The final activity involved building a small bridge from paper and testing how much weight it could support.
primaryTranslation: 最后一项活动是用纸搭小桥，测试它能承受多大重量。

english: movie
primaryExample: The film follows a family who restore an old boat and use it to explore the coast.
primaryTranslation: 这部电影讲述一家人修复旧船，再用它探索海岸的故事。

english: early part of the day before 12 noon
primaryExample: We arrived early in the morning, when the market was opening and the streets were still quiet.
primaryTranslation: 我们一大早到达，那时集市正开市，街道仍很安静。

english: situation where armies fight each other
primaryExample: The museum explains how the war affected ordinary families, using letters and photographs donated by local residents.
primaryTranslation: 博物馆用当地居民捐赠的信件和照片，说明战争如何影响普通家庭。

english: arrangement with a bank to keep your money for you
primaryExample: She opened a separate account to keep money for the project apart from her everyday spending.
primaryTranslation: 她另开了一个账户，把项目资金与日常开支分开。

english: place which sells things
primaryExample: The little shop beside the station sells maps and useful supplies for people exploring the nearby countryside.
primaryTranslation: 车站旁的小商店销售地图和实用补给，供游览附近乡村的人使用。

english: important, serious, or large in scope
primaryExample: The lack of public transport is a major problem for residents who do not have their own cars.
primaryTranslation: 对没有私家车的居民而言，公共交通不足是一个主要问题。

english: person who is not known or named
primaryExample: We need someone who can explain the instructions clearly and help visitors who have never used this equipment.
primaryTranslation: 我们需要一位能讲清说明，并帮助首次使用设备的游客的人。

english: in a higher place than something else
primaryExample: The notice above explains which materials can be recycled and where visitors should put them after the workshop.
primaryTranslation: 上面的告示说明哪些材料可以回收，以及工作坊后应该放在哪里。

english: to plan in a particular way to fulfill a purpose
primaryExample: The students will design a small shelter that protects visitors from rain without blocking the view across the valley.
primaryTranslation: 学生们将设计一个小棚，既能为游客挡雨，又不挡住山谷景色。

english: something that happens
primaryExample: The event brings together local artists who want to share their skills with people of different ages.
primaryTranslation: 这项活动汇集了想向不同年龄人群分享技能的当地艺术家。

english: different from what is usual; better or greater than normal
primaryExample: We prepared a special meal to thank the neighbours who had helped us during the long house repairs.
primaryTranslation: 我们做了一顿特别的饭，感谢在漫长房屋维修期间帮忙的邻居。

english: only at certain times; occasionally
primaryExample: The road sometimes floods after heavy rain, so residents check the conditions before driving into the valley.
primaryTranslation: 大雨后道路有时会积水，因此居民开车进山谷前会查看路况。

english: state of living you are in (e.g., good health)
primaryExample: The bicycle was still in good condition, although its owner had used it almost every day for years.
primaryTranslation: 这辆自行车虽被车主多年来几乎天天使用，但状况仍然良好。

english: to hold something and move it to another place
primaryExample: Please carry the glass bottles separately so that they do not knock against the tools in your bag.
primaryTranslation: 请分开携带玻璃瓶，以免它们碰到包里的工具。

english: to select; decide between several possibilities
primaryExample: Visitors can choose a shorter walk if they want more time to explore the village before returning.
primaryTranslation: 想在返程前多花时间游村的游客，可以选择较短的步行路线。

english: a male parent
primaryExample: Her father showed her how to repair the chair, explaining why each piece had to fit tightly.
primaryTranslation: 她父亲教她修椅子，并解释每块零件为何都必须装得紧密。

english: a choice you make about something after thinking about it
primaryExample: We postponed the final decision until everyone had a chance to compare the costs of the different plans.
primaryTranslation: 我们推迟最终决定，让每个人都有机会比较不同方案的费用。

english: raised flat surface
primaryExample: We moved the table closer to the window so that everyone could see the photographs in natural light.
primaryTranslation: 我们把桌子移近窗户，让大家都能在自然光下看照片。

english: being sure about something; without doubt
primaryExample: We were certain that the route was correct because it matched the description in the guidebook exactly.
primaryTranslation: 我们确信路线没错，因为它与指南中的描述完全一致。

english: toward what is ahead or in front
primaryExample: The queue moved forward slowly while staff checked tickets and answered questions about the evening's performance.
primaryTranslation: 工作人员检票并答复当晚演出相关问题时，队伍慢慢向前移动。

english: most important; most often used
primaryExample: The main entrance is closed for repairs, so visitors should follow the signs to the smaller side door.
primaryTranslation: 正门因维修关闭，因此游客应按指示前往较小的侧门。

english: to stop living
primaryExample: Several young plants began to die after being left in the hot greenhouse without enough water.
primaryTranslation: 几株幼苗因被留在炎热温室里又缺水，开始枯死。

english: large brown animal with fur that lives in forests
primaryExample: The guide explained how a bear searches for food before the colder months, when fewer plants are available.
primaryTranslation: 导游解释了熊如何在植物变少的寒冷月份前寻找食物。

english: to use a knife or scissors to divide or open the surface
primaryExample: Please cut the cardboard along the marked lines so that the pieces will fit together correctly later.
primaryTranslation: 请沿标记线裁纸板，让各部分稍后能正确拼合。

english: to tell someone the appearance, sound or smell of something
primaryExample: Can you describe the missing bag clearly enough for the station staff to recognise it if it appears?
primaryTranslation: 你能把丢失的包描述清楚，让车站工作人员发现时认出来吗？

english: the same (male) person who did the action
primaryExample: Although the instructions looked difficult, he managed to assemble the shelves himself without asking his neighbour for help.
primaryTranslation: 虽然说明看起来很难，他还是没找邻居帮忙，自己装好了架子。

english: present and able to be used
primaryExample: Several places are still available on the afternoon tour, but you should book before leaving the information centre.
primaryTranslation: 下午的导览还剩几个名额，但你应在离开咨询中心前预订。

english: more than usual; extremely
primaryExample: The shaded path is especially pleasant during summer, when the open fields become too hot for comfortable walking.
primaryTranslation: 夏天开阔田野热得不适合舒适步行时，这条林荫小路尤其宜人。

english: having big muscles; physically powerful
primaryExample: The strong volunteer carried the heavy boxes upstairs while the rest of us prepared the tables.
primaryTranslation: 那位强壮的志愿者把重箱子搬上楼，其余人则准备桌子。

english: to move from a lower position to a higher one
primaryExample: We watched the sun rise above the hills while waiting for the first boat to leave the harbour.
primaryTranslation: 等待第一班船驶离港口时，我们看着太阳从山上升起。

english: a female child
primaryExample: The girl who designed the poster explained how she had chosen colours that people could recognise easily.
primaryTranslation: 设计海报的女孩解释了，她如何选出容易被人识别的颜色。

english: possibly but not certainly; perhaps
primaryExample: Maybe we should visit the smaller gallery first, since it usually closes earlier than the main museum.
primaryTranslation: 也许我们该先去较小的画廊，因为它通常比主博物馆关门早。

english: group of people who share a common idea or area
primaryExample: The local community worked together to restore the park, sharing tools and organising activities for younger residents.
primaryTranslation: 当地社区齐心修复公园，共享工具，也为年轻居民组织活动。

english: otherwise; if you fail to...
primaryExample: Finish labelling the boxes before the delivery arrives, or else we may send them to the wrong addresses.
primaryTranslation: 送货车来之前先贴好箱子标签，否则我们可能寄错地址。

english: one specific (one)
primaryExample: We chose this particular route because it passed the old watermill that my grandfather had described to us.
primaryTranslation: 我们特意选这条路线，因为它经过爷爷曾向我们描述的老水磨坊。

english: character played by an actor
primaryExample: She prepared carefully for her role as a village teacher in the play, studying photographs from the period.
primaryTranslation: 她为剧中乡村教师的角色认真准备，研究了那个年代的照片。

english: to bring something close to another, to become one
primaryExample: We need to join the two wooden sections securely before adding the wheels to the model cart.
primaryTranslation: 给小车模型装轮子前，我们需要先把两段木制部分牢固连接起来。

primaryCollocations.chinese: 把一部分接到另一部分
